lines.en: Stroll through the grass
Move through the forest slowly
Curious gaze at you
Low form skims the ground
Move leisurely among the rocks
Light sound passing through leaves
Tail brushes the ground gently

lines.zh: 轻微的窸窣声引起注意
lines.en: Slight rustle catches attention
Pass by quietly nearby
Occasionally nudge you with its mouth
My thin legs whirl fast.
I slip past your ankles.
I dart among the bush roots.
A leaf crackles and startles me.
My tail swings to steer.
I trot along behind your boots.
Lies quietly in the sun
Chews slowly on grass
Wanders slowly in place
Enjoys the warm afternoon

lines.zh: 静静地观察周围的动静
lines.en: Stays still, watching the surroundings
Occasionally stretches
Yawns and stretches lazily
Enjoys the breeze
Stays still, waiting for something
Enjoys the calm
I lie down and lick my claws.
My eye follows a passing bug.
My tail taps the ground slowly.
I tuck my neck and play at being a stone.

lines.zh: 你一动，我脖子先伸长了。
lines.en: You move, and my neck stretches out first.
I only reach your knees.

lines.zh: 靠近你时发出细微的声音
lines.en: Makes a soft sound when approaching you
Small as I am, my call is loud.
Nudges you gently with its mouth
Approaches you, seemingly wanting to be close
Gazes at you with gentle eyes
Approaches you, making a soft sound
Keeps an alert eye on you
Taps you gently with its nose
I look up at you, then down.

lines.zh: 鼻子抽动，记住你的味道。
lines.en: My snout twitches, memorizing your scent.
Your hands smell of meat.
I circle to your other side.

lines.zh: 你踩到的影子让我缩了缩。
lines.en: Your step's shadow makes me flinch.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑到你靴边闻。
lines.en: I bring my snout to your boot and sniff.
My body can't handle this!
Not feeling well...
My legs are weak...
This hurts too much. I need mommy.
Find a nest. I'm tired.

lines.zh: 伤口好疼，求求你别动我。
lines.en: Ouch, don't move me.
Ouch, I'm hurt.
I'm hungry and hurt.
My leg is broken. Need food.
Stop hitting me!
I'm hungry, give me meat!
Your meat smells so good!
Some small meat, please!
Is this meat tender?
No bones, give me meat!
Look at these tasty bits!
Here, give me some food!
These meats will last me days!

lines.zh: 我还没吃饱，再多给我点！
lines.en: I'm still hungry, give me more!
These bits are perfect for me!
Watch out for my little claws!
I move fast!
Don't touch me! I'm not hungry!

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴，扫起一层落叶。
lines.en: I whip my tail and kick up a layer of leaves.
Stay back, I'm angry!
I'll play a chasing game with you!

lines.zh: 小心，我的牙只有一颗尖。
lines.en: Careful — only one of my teeth is sharp.
I only eat plants, don't worry!

lines.zh: 你靴子一挪，我弹开老远。
lines.en: One shift of your boot sends me springing back.

lines.zh: 我跑得很快，追不上我的！
lines.en: I run very fast, you can't catch me!

lines.zh: 我这么小，也会认真求偶。
lines.en: Small as I am, I court in earnest.
Find a good place to mate!
My wings are light!
Let's go for a walk together!
Your touch feels good!
I'll sing for you!

lines.zh: 我清嗓子，叫得比身子响。
lines.en: I clear my throat and call louder than my size.
My feathers are soft!
I attract you with my voice!
My wings are big!
Compsognathus leg bone!
Food here!
Eat up!

lines.zh: 六点血的小家伙，别捏我。
lines.en: A six-point little guy — don't squeeze me.
Feeding you!
You're hungry!
Your dinner!
Eat me up!
My leg bone!
Eat, eat!
Prey over there!

lines.zh: 虫子停在石头上，尾巴先僵。
lines.en: A bug lands on the stone; my tail freezes first.
Beware of that!
It's coming!
It's there!
I see it!
It's moving!
My food!
It's lingering there!
Lock on!
A leaf moved; I fixed on it.
A bug crawls over the stone.
I crouch low and hold my breath.
The little thing has not noticed me.
I lower my head; the tip of my tail trembles.

lines.zh: 蕨影里就我一双亮眼睛。
lines.en: In the fern shade only my bright eyes show.

lines.zh: 我蹲在蕨叶后，等你转身。
lines.en: Crouched behind the ferns, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 我只有六点血，可我会咬。
lines.en: I've only six hearts, but I still bite.

lines.zh: 我这么小，也只敢咬你脚踝。
lines.en: I'm small; your ankle is all I dare bite.

lines.zh: 我只到你脚踝，可我咬得准。
lines.en: I only reach your ankle, but I bite true.

lines.zh: 你退到草丛，我绕到后面。
lines.en: You back into the grass; I slip behind you.

lines.zh: 细腿一蹬，草叶被我拨开。
lines.en: My thin legs push off; grass parts around me.
Small as I am, I outrun you.
Swallow you whole!

lines.zh: 我贴着蕨叶根，蹭近半尺。
lines.en: I hug the fern base and creep half a foot closer.
My hind legs are coiled to pounce.
I aim for its tail.
Small as I am, I can still bite you.
I'm small, but I still get a bite.
Hisses, lightly bites the ground.
Tail swishes, making rustling sounds.
Opens its mouth, gently pecks at prey.

lines.zh: 用尖爪踢踏，发出咔咔声。
lines.en: Kicks with its sharp claws, making cracking sounds.
Growls lowly, warning the intruder.
Makes cracking sounds, chewing food.
Waves its forelimbs, trying to chase away.
Spreads its wings, preparing to take flight.
Gently bites the opponent, testing its response.
Murmurs lowly, showing threat.
I bite and shake my head.
Both foreclaws pin it down.
I miss the bite; it gets away.
A tiny bite is still meat.
Crawls out from the rock layer.
Jumps out from the grassy丛中轻巧跃出。

lines.zh: 从裂缝中滑出，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Slithers out from the crack, searching for prey.
Appears from the shadow quietly.
Slowly awakens in the cave.
Creeps out from the ground.
Lurks near the rock, waiting.
Pokes its head out from the bushes.
Appears in the abandoned mine.
Appears quietly from the dark area.
My eggshell splits; I shake myself off.

lines.zh: 我从巢里的枯叶堆钻出来。
lines.en: I wriggle out of the nest's dry leaves.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，看见的是石头。
lines.en: My first sight is stone.
I step onto warm sand.

lines.zh: 孵化器打开了，我迈出一步。
lines.en: The incubator opens; I take a step.
I slide down the earthen bank.

lines.zh: 细小的脚印留在了泥里。
lines.en: Tiny footprints stay in the mud.

lines.zh: 蛋壳碎在我脚边，风很冷。
lines.en: Shell shards at my feet; the wind is cold.

lines.zh: 我从石堆的缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a gap in the rocks.
The grass outside is taller than I expected.

lines.zh: 小身板受不住啦，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My body can't handle this! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 伤得不轻啊，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Not feeling well — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 腿软软的，走不动了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My legs are weak — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 疼得不行了，得找妈妈，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: This hurts too much. I need mommy — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 快找个窝，我要休息，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Find a nest. I'm tired — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 伤口好疼，求求你别动我，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, don't move me — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 哎呦，摔伤了，好疼，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, I'm hurt — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 受伤了，我好饿啊，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm hungry and hurt — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 腿断了，快找吃的，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My leg is broken. Need food — and the void makes it worse.
